<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,7,0,0><CHAR 1,3,1,0,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Andra!
I saw the ≪Mysterious Village≫,
so I came to report.

<TALK 5><NAME 10>A village, you say...
There should be no village
unregistered with the guild...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,4>Yes! As we went through the forest,
the space ahead looked badly warped.

Before we knew it a village was there...
It looked like one under rebuilding.

<CHAR 1,0,1,1,0><CV 1,60>I wanted to help, but...
for some reason no one noticed us.

A cute winged woman, a beautiful
sheep-like woman... many people,
but none noticed us.

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0>I thought I might help
with the rebuilding...

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,22>Goodness, could that be
the village of the hidden gods...?
A truly strange phenomenon.
<CV 5,35>Anyway, I must investigate that village...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,74>No, that's the thing...
even when I visited again,
I couldn't find it at all...

<ITEM PCOIN00063,1,0>Instead, something like this
was lying there...

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,23>Hmm...
what in the world is this...

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,7>No — could this be the
<COL C70101FF>≪Village Chief Coin≫</COL>...?
There is something similar in legend.

<CV 5,34>This coin, it is said, belonged
to a youth who rebuilt a village.

<CV 5,7>Yes, you lot — won't you
gather these Village Chief Coins?

<ITEM 0,1,1>Gather these coins and the village
you saw might be rebuilt.

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,87><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1>Really!?
We'll go and gather them!

<CV 1,7>Any village, if it's suffering,
we must help!

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,19>Hmm, I leave it to you.
As thanks, poor word that it is,
I'll prepare gear to match.

<ITEM AD_BODY2067,1,1>This gear is said to imitate
a figure from the Village Chief Coin legend.

Evolve it, and for one just starting
to explore, it should prove
quite useful.
<CV 5,20><ITEM 0,1,0>Then, I leave it to you!
<CLS>
